title: Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract Claim Conditions and Repair Facility Terms by Plan
content:
These are the claim conditions and repair facility terms of each Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract plan, as applied by the claims desk to a repair facility's claim.

## Waiting period and claim documentation

| Plan | Waiting period after purchase (calendar days) | Waiting period beyond the odometer at purchase (miles) | Repair facility must obtain authorization before starting a covered repair | Maintenance records may be requested on a claim |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Powertrain | 30 | 1000 | Yes | Yes |
| Kestrel Care Gold | 30 | 1000 | Yes | Yes |
| Kestrel Care Gold Plus | 30 | 1000 | Yes | Yes |
| Kestrel Care Platinum | 30 | 1000 | Yes | Yes |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Plus | 30 | 1000 | Yes | Yes |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Elite | 30 | 1000 | Yes | Yes |

## Repair facility, labor, parts and repair lines

| Plan | Labor paid, as a percent of the facility's posted retail labor rate | Diagnostic time paid when the failure is covered | Kestrel genuine parts required | ASE-certified independent facility allowed | Repair lines that may be claimed on one repair visit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Powertrain | 100 | Yes | No | Yes | 3 |
| Kestrel Care Gold | 100 | Yes | No | Yes | 5 |
| Kestrel Care Gold Plus | 100 | Yes | Yes | Yes | 6 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum | 100 | Yes | Yes | Yes | 8 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Plus | 100 | Yes | Yes | Yes | 10 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Elite | 100 | Yes | Yes | No | 12 |

## Notes

- The waiting period in days is counted in calendar days from the plan's purchase date; the waiting period in miles is counted beyond the odometer reading at purchase.
- Labor is paid at the percent shown of the facility's own posted retail labor rate; at 100 percent that is the posted rate itself.
- Kestrel Care Platinum Elite is the only plan on which repairs may not be performed at an ASE-certified independent facility.
- The repair-line figure is a count per repair visit: on Kestrel Care Powertrain, for example, a visit can carry covered repair lines up to 3.
